constructor.details: Initializes the upgradeable proxy with the initial implementation and admin

params.admin_: Address of the admin of the proxy
params.data_: Data used in a delegate call to implementation. The delegate call will be     skipped if the data is empty bytes

params.forceCall_: Forces make delegate call to the implementation even with empty data_
params.setupCalldata_: Data for the setup call. The call is skipped if setupCalldata_ is     empty and forceCall_ is false

proxy__changeAdmin(address).notice: Changes the admin of the proxy

proxy__getAdmin().notice: Returns the current admin of the proxy

proxy__getIsOssified().notice: Returns whether the implementation is locked forever

proxy__ossify().notice: Allows to transfer admin rights to zero address and prevent future     upgrades of the proxy

proxy__upgradeTo(address).notice: Upgrades the implementation of the proxy

proxy__upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes,bo.notice: Upgrades the proxy to a new implementation, optionally performing an additional     setup call.
